title: 第5章 站队第6章 拜托了未来的我
lines: 随着克洛诺斯留下这声充斥着无尽恨意的咆哮，周身爆发出强烈的时空波动，狼狈的逃窜出了天际。
而随着他的逃离，战场上令人窒息的威压缓缓散去，只留下遍地疮痍。
半毁的宫殿，开裂的大地，被神力余波清空的云层......以及身上都带着不少伤痕，尤其是作为主攻手的波塞冬和哈迪斯，他们的伤口处还残留着收割神力的侵蚀气息，正在缓慢愈合。
宙斯和墨提斯都呆呆地站在原地，眼神中还残留着目睹那场惊世围攻的震撼与茫然。
即便是见多识广的泰坦神后瑞亚，看着自己这五个子女所展现出的超越想象的伟力，也不禁微微张嘴，眼中神色复杂难明。
胜利，以一种完全偏离神话原轨的方式，被这五姐弟夺取。
在原本的命运丝线中，这里应是宙斯凭借智慧与勇气，主导击败克洛诺斯，树立起新一代领袖威望的关键节点。
但由于波塞冬这个“异数”带来的连锁反应，他连同他的兄弟姐妹们，已经强悍到了足以靠自己的力量正面击退一位完全体的神王。
宙斯终于从震撼中回过神来，他强压下心中的惊涛骇浪，准备按照之前的想法来。
“诸位兄姐神力如此强绝，我这做弟弟的，真是......倍感安心。如今邪恶之父已被击退，但其势力犹在，必不会善罢甘休。吾等当尽快集结力量，整合有志反抗暴政的同胞，准备迎接与泰坦神族的全面战争！”
按照他和墨提斯、瑞亚的计划，接下来自然是由他这位“预言中的救世主”“最小的弟弟”来主导整合力量，顺理成章地成为联军统帅。
母亲瑞亚的支持，智慧墨提斯的辅佐，加上盖亚的隐约认可，宙斯认为，即便这些兄姐力量强大，在“大义”与“亲情”面前，也应该会顺势接受他的领导。
“哦？这里居然还有一个比波塞冬更不懂礼数的家伙。那个金发的，且不论你是谁。你凭什么认为我们要听你的号令，去准备什么战争？
而第一个发出质疑的，果然是哈迪斯。
他不知何时已拭去嘴角一丝血迹，重新将自己笼罩在淡淡的黑雾中，只露出一双比深渊更冷的眼眸，静静地看着宙斯。
哈迪斯是一个对“地位”和“权力”有着近乎本能渴望与敏感的神。
在自家人面前吃瘪归吃瘪，但在“外人”面前，他绝不会允许任何存在凌驾于自己之上，尤其是这个突然冒出来，一副理所当然模样的“弟弟”。
“啧，又扯上我。”波塞冬掏了掏耳朵，满不在乎，“不过这家伙话糙理不糙。战争是肯定要打的，那老混蛋逃走时那眼神，摆明是去摇人了。”
“问题是——这位小姐，还有我们‘初次见面’的母亲大人，似乎很想让咱们这位最小的弟弟来当这个发号施令的人呢。”
赫拉罕见的没有发火，只是双手抱胸，赤瞳斜睨着宙斯，又扫了一眼他身旁的瑞亚和墨提斯，冷冷道。
但她特意加重了“初次见面”几个字，其中的疏离与阴阳不言而喻。
赫斯提亚只是温柔地笑了笑，没有接话。德墨忒尔也保持着娴静的沉默。
不过，赫拉的按捺更像是碍于瑞亚刚刚展现出的足以抵挡她的神力，以及那层尴尬的“母女”名分，才勉强忍住的。
content_en:
As Cronus left this roar filled with endless hatred, strong space-time fluctuations erupted all over his body, and he fled out of the sky in embarrassment.
As he fled, the suffocating pressure on the battlefield slowly dissipated, leaving only devastation everywhere.
The half-destroyed palace, the cracked earth, the clouds cleared by the aftermath of the divine power... and there were many scars on their bodies, especially Poseidon and Hades, who were the main attackers. Their wounds still had the corrosive aura of harvesting the divine power, and were slowly healing.
Zeus and Metis both stood there blankly, with the shock and confusion of witnessing that shocking siege still in their eyes.
Even Rhea, the well-informed Titan God Queen, couldn't help but open her mouth slightly when she saw the power beyond imagination displayed by her five children, with a complicated look in her eyes.
Victory was won by these five siblings in a way that completely deviated from the original track of the myth.
In the original thread of fate, this should be the key node where Zeus led the defeat of Cronus with his wisdom and courage and established the prestige of a new generation of leaders.
But due to the chain reaction brought about by Poseidon's "odd number", he, together with his brothers and sisters, has become strong enough to defeat a complete god-king on his own.
"Uh... that..."
Zeus finally recovered from the shock. He suppressed the turmoil in his heart and prepared to follow his previous thoughts.
"You brothers and sisters are so powerful. As a younger brother, I feel...very relieved. Now that the father of evil has been defeated, his power is still there and he will not give up. We must gather our strength as soon as possible, integrate our compatriots who are willing to resist the tyranny, and prepare for an all-out war with the Titans!"
According to his plan with Metis and Rhea, it would be natural for him, the "prophesied savior" and "youngest brother", to take the lead in integrating the forces and naturally become the commander-in-chief of the coalition forces.
With the support of his mother Rhea, the assistance of the wise Metis, and the vague recognition of Gaia, Zeus believed that even if these brothers and sisters were powerful, they should accept his leadership in the face of "righteousness" and "family affection".
"Oh? There is actually a guy here who is even less polite than Poseidon. That blond guy, no matter who you are. Why do you think we should listen to your orders and prepare for some kind of war?
And the first one to question was indeed Hades.
He didn't know when he had wiped away a trace of blood from the corner of his mouth, and enveloped himself in the faint black mist again, revealing only a pair of eyes colder than the abyss, looking at Zeus quietly.
Hades is a god with an almost instinctive desire and sensitivity for "status" and "power."
He feels deflated in front of his own family, but in front of "outsiders", he will never allow anyone to override him, especially this "brother" who suddenly appears and takes it for granted.
"Tsk, drag me in again. Poseidon picked his ears and said nonchalantly, "But this guy's words are rough. The war will definitely be fought, and the look in the old bastard's eyes when he ran away made it clear that he was trying to shake people up. "
"The problem is - this young lady, and the mother we met for the first time, seem to want our youngest brother to be the one giving orders. "
Hera, who was rare, did not get angry, but folded her arms, squinting at Zeus with her red eyes, then glanced at Rhea and Metis beside him, and said coldly.
But she deliberately emphasized the words "first meeting", and the alienation and yin and yang in it are self-evident.
Hestia just smiled softly and didn't answer. Demeter also maintained a demure silence.
However, Hera's suppression was more likely due to the fact that Rhea had just shown the power to withstand her and the awkward status of "mother and daughter", so she could barely hold back.
title_en: Chapter 5: Taking Team Chapter 6: Please Ask My Future Me
